responsibility: Adds trait-diagnostic helper methods directly on `InferCtxt` for function-like obligations: it extracts HIR-based argument-shape summaries for closures, functions, trait items, impl items, and constructors; builds the `E0593` argument-count mismatch diagnostic with closure/tuple-argument rewrite suggestions; and probes whether a type satisfies one of the `Fn`/`FnMut`/`FnOnce` traits while recovering the corresponding argument tuple type for use by higher-level trait error reporting.
